Kill [[Ghial the Bone Dancer]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Ghial the Bone Dancer in the [[Xaquang Skyway]].
* *BONUS* Kill Ghial in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Exit from [[the Marketplace]] into [[Bukdek Byway]] and then enter Xaquang Skyway or exit from [[Senji's Corner]] and head north. See maps for directions. The route from the Marketplace to Ghial is faster as your [[party]] will encounter fewer foes than the route from Senji's Corner; however, Senji's Corner has a wider selection of [[Henchman|henchmen]].

Ghial relies on his [[Flesh Golem]] for offense and [[Taste of Death|self healing]] as it leaves an exploitable corpse. Consider bringing an [[Corpse#Corpse exploiting skills|exploit skill]] to prevent Ghial from reusing the corpse.
